On Vivo X200 Ultra, long pressing the power button triggers Vivo\'s built-in BlueLM / Copilot assistant by default with no native option to remap it.\n\nOriginOS 6 does not deliver KEYCODE_POWER to accessibility (camera shutter keys still arrive). Viva la Circle therefore watches for the Copilot window, dismisses it, and launches your chosen action.
Tap \'Enable in Accessibility Settings\' above to navigate to system settings.
Scroll down to \'Downloaded Apps\' or \'Installed Services\' section.
Find and select \'Viva la Circle\' from the list.
Turn on \'Use Viva la Circle\' toggle and confirm system permissions.

Once enabled, the service runs quietly in the background:

• OriginOS 6 does not give accessibility the power key, so Copilot still opens. The service dismisses that window, waits, then fires your BlueLM action.
• Short-press Power is unchanged (the ROM keeps it).
• Camera shutter remains a separate hardware-key intercept.
EMUI / HarmonyOS will stop the accessibility service unless this app is set to Manage manually under Settings → Battery → App launch (allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch, and Run in background).
Open Settings → Battery → App launch → Viva la Circle
Install com.tosharoki.hwcts, or pick another action. Huawei devices without this package cannot use HwCTS circle search.
